gnome_settings_daemon_name.description: Name of the gnome-settings-daemon executable. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#elif which gnome-settings-daemon >/dev/null; then).

gnome_settings_daemon_path.description: Path to the gnome-settings-daemon executable directory. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#if test -x /usr/libexec/gnome-settings-daemon >/dev/null; then).

xfce_mcs_manager.description: xfce-mcs-manager (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#xfce-mcs-manager &).
